title: Changes in life
text: Wang Bing: Hi, Grandpa and Grandma. I'm doing a project on life in the past and now. Can you tell me about the changes in your life?
Grandpa: Sure. In the past, I wrote letters to my family and friends. Now I chat with them on the internet.
Grandma: And we spent a lot of time on the road then. Now high-speed trains travel very fast.
Wang Bing: Mum, what was your life like in the past?
Mum: In the past, I worked in an office. These days, I sometimes work from home and have online meetings.
